english_definition: Absolutely necessary.
example_sentence: Clean water is essential for life.

english_definition: Forming the base or most important part.
example_sentence: Respect is fundamental to any relationship.

english_definition: Causing public disagreement.
example_sentence: Animal testing is a controversial subject.

english_definition: A strong effect on something.
example_sentence: Social media has a big impact on young people.

english_definition: One of several things that influence a result.
example_sentence: Cost is a key factor when choosing a university.

english_definition: An important topic that people discuss.
example_sentence: Traffic congestion is a major issue in big cities.

english_definition: To be likely to do something or to happen often.
example_sentence: Young people tend to spend more time online.

english_definition: To accept that something is true without checking.
example_sentence: People often assume that expensive means better.

english_definition: To accept that something is true or exists.
example_sentence: We must acknowledge the risks of the plan.

english_definition: To keep something at the same level, or to state an opinion firmly.
example_sentence: She maintains that school uniforms are unnecessary.

english_definition: A clear difference between two things.
example_sentence: There is a sharp contrast between city and village life.

english_definition: Also, and more importantly.
example_sentence: The plan is cheap; moreover, it is quick to carry out.

english_definition: In spite of that.
example_sentence: The test was hard; nevertheless, most students passed.

english_definition: Used to compare two different things.
example_sentence: Cities are crowded, whereas villages are quiet.

english_definition: For that reason.
example_sentence: Prices are rising; therefore, many people save less.

english_definition: As a result.
example_sentence: The factory closed; consequently, many workers lost their jobs.

english_definition: In spite of the fact that.
example_sentence: Although it was expensive, the course was worth it.

english_definition: In the same way.
example_sentence: Parents should be role models; likewise, teachers should set an example.

english_definition: The business of providing services for people who travel for pleasure.
example_sentence: Tourism is the main source of income for the island.

english_definition: The place where someone or something is going.
example_sentence: Da Nang is a popular holiday destination.

english_definition: A place to live or stay.
example_sentence: Student accommodation is cheap near the campus.

english_definition: A detailed plan of a journey.
example_sentence: Our itinerary includes three cities in five days.

english_definition: An official document that you need to travel abroad.
example_sentence: You must show your passport at the border.

english_definition: An act of travelling from one place to another.
example_sentence: The journey from Hanoi to Hue takes about an hour by plane.

english_definition: A building or place that is easy to recognise.
example_sentence: The tower is the best-known landmark in the city.

english_definition: A place that people visit for interest or enjoyment.
example_sentence: The museum is a major tourist attraction.

english_definition: The basic systems of a country, such as roads and electricity.
example_sentence: Good infrastructure attracts foreign investment.

english_definition: A situation in which a place is too crowded, especially with traffic.
example_sentence: Traffic congestion wastes time and fuel.

english_definition: A person who walks rather than travels in a vehicle.
example_sentence: The new bridge is for pedestrians only.

english_definition: Buses, trains and other services that anyone can use.
example_sentence: Public transport is cheaper than owning a car.

english_definition: A notice that tries to persuade people to buy something.
example_sentence: The advertisement for the phone appeared everywhere.

english_definition: A programme on television or radio.
example_sentence: The live broadcast attracted millions of viewers.

english_definition: A person who writes news reports for newspapers or television.
example_sentence: The journalist interviewed the mayor.

english_definition: A famous person.
example_sentence: Celebrities often influence what young people buy.

english_definition: Films, music and other things that people enjoy watching.
example_sentence: Home entertainment has changed with streaming.

english_definition: A film that gives facts about a real subject.
example_sentence: The documentary explains how glaciers are melting.

english_definition: A public show of art or other objects.
example_sentence: The exhibition features paintings from the last century.

english_definition: A special event or celebration, often held every year.
example_sentence: The lantern festival attracts visitors from abroad.

english_definition: A building where important objects are kept and shown.
example_sentence: Entry to the national museum is free on Sundays.

english_definition: A style of cooking.
